verdict.rationale: GoDaddy's docs describe a fixed auto-renew toggle for domains (godaddy-docs-5/20) but there is no evidence of a general-purpose scheduler, cron-like job system, or workflow-automation engine that lets an AI-native user define and schedule arbitrary recurring jobs via the API, CLI, or MCP server. The MCP and gddy CLI docs (godaddy-docs-12,13,14,23,24) only describe one-shot conversational/CLI actions like search, register, or DNS updates, not recurring workflow scheduling.
